data.title: Vehicle Export Financing Fraud — Auto Loan Followed by Rapid Title Transfer or Export with Active Lien
data.description: Detects the vehicle export financing fraud pattern where an auto loan application is approved and the financed vehicle undergoes rapid title transfer or appears in export documentation while the loan remains active and the lien is outstanding. INTERPOL's 2026 Global Financial Fraud Threat Assessment documents this as a growing transnational fraud scheme first detected in North America in early 2024, where criminal networks use identity theft and straw buyers to obtain auto loans for high-value vehicles, then export them overseas before lenders detect fraud. The critical detection window is the period between vehicle delivery and export — often as short as 7-21 days. Key indicators include high-value vehicles (>$30,000) with high LTV ratios, fewer than 3 loan payments made, title transfer events within 60 days of origination, and GPS telematics showing vehicle departure from the borrower's stated area toward port cities or border crossings. The structural delay between loan default and fraud detection is the primary vulnerability exploited by these networks.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_title_event AND filter_loan_status AND filter_vehicle_category

enrichment_required.source: DMV title transfer records cross-referenced with loan origination date
CBP pre-departure export manifest data for recently financed VINs
Vehicle GPS telematics last known position (where lender telematics installed)
Boolean flag if GPS last ping is within 50 miles of port of departure or international border crossing

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Vehicle Export Financing Fraud
// Detects high-value auto loans with rapid title transfer or export indicators
loan_type="auto"
vehicle_value>=30000
payments_made<=3
title_transfer_days_since_origination<=60
(vehicle_category="pickup_truck" OR vehicle_category="suv" OR vehicle_category="luxury")
| days_to_title_transfer := title_transfer_days_since_origination
| groupBy(loan_id, function=[
    collect([vehicle_vin, vehicle_value, loan_amount, ltv_ratio,
             origination_date, dealership_name, borrower_id, borrower_zip,
             payments_made, loan_status, days_to_title_transfer,
             gps_last_location, export_manifest_match])
  ])
| sort(vehicle_value, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Vehicle Export Financing Fraud")`
`comment("Detects auto loans on high-value vehicles with rapid title transfer and few payments")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auto_lending
  loan_type="auto"
  vehicle_value>=30000
  payments_made<=3
  title_transfer_days_since_origination<=60
  (vehicle_category="pickup_truck" OR vehicle_category="suv" OR vehicle_category="luxury")
| eval risk_score = case(
    title_transfer_days_since_origination < 14 AND export_manifest_match="true", "critical",
    title_transfer_days_since_origination < 30 AND payments_made <= 1, "critical",
    title_transfer_days_since_origination < 45 AND ltv_ratio >= 0.95, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| lookup dealership_fraud_history dealership_id OUTPUT prior_fraud_count, dealership_risk_tier
| table loan_id, vehicle_vin, vehicle_value, vehicle_category, loan_amount, ltv_ratio,
        origination_date, dealership_name, dealership_risk_tier, borrower_id, borrower_zip,
        payments_made, loan_status, title_transfer_days_since_origination,
        gps_last_location, gps_port_proximity, export_manifest_match, risk_score
| sort - risk_score, - vehicle_value
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Vehicle Export Financing Fraud
-- Detects auto loans with rapid title transfer or export activity while lien is active
SELECT
  la.loan_id,
  la.vehicle_vin,
  la.vehicle_value,
  la.vehicle_category,
  la.loan_amount,
  la.ltv_ratio,
  la.origination_date,
  la.dealership_id,
  la.dealership_name,
  la.borrower_id,
  la.borrower_zip,
  lp.payments_made,
  lp.loan_status,
  tt.title_transfer_date,
  DATEDIFF('day', la.origination_date, tt.title_transfer_date) AS days_to_title_transfer,
  gps.last_known_location,
  gps.port_proximity_flag,
  em.export_manifest_date
FROM loan_applications la
JOIN loan_payment_history lp ON la.loan_id = lp.loan_id
LEFT JOIN dmv_title_transfers tt ON la.vehicle_vin = tt.vehicle_vin
LEFT JOIN vehicle_gps_telematics gps ON la.vehicle_vin = gps.vehicle_vin
LEFT JOIN cbp_export_manifests em ON la.vehicle_vin = em.vehicle_vin
WHERE la.loan_type = 'auto'
  AND la.vehicle_value >= 30000
  AND la.vehicle_category IN ('pickup_truck', 'suv', 'luxury')
  AND lp.payments_made <= 3
  AND lp.loan_status IN ('active', 'delinquent', 'default')
  AND (
    (tt.title_transfer_date IS NOT NULL
     AND DATEDIFF('day', la.origination_date, tt.title_transfer_date) <= 60)
    OR em.export_manifest_date IS NOT NULL
    OR gps.port_proximity_flag = TRUE
  )
ORDER BY la.vehicle_value DESC

references: INTERPOL Global Financial Fraud Threat Assessment, 2nd Edition, March 2026
INTERPOL GFFTA 2026 — Americas: INTERPOL Uncovers Fraudulent Vehicle Export Scheme
INTERPOL Stolen Vehicle Database — cross-border tracing limitations
falsepositives: Legitimate vehicle sale by borrower who pays off loan balance at title transfer
Fleet vehicle purchase by business with rapid deployment to multiple locations
Military member transferring vehicle to overseas duty station with proper lender notification
Borrower legitimately relocating near a port city or border area shortly after purchase
